status: changes required before launch; V9 receipts not terminal or reviewed
positive: Gates require branch, exit, source unchanged, full report result and source_commit equal prescribed actual code-cut heads, exactly two checker/browser case IDs and both source heads.
All recorded V9 scope inputs are rehashed before launch; V10 timeout and V11 rejection evidence currently match the controller predicates.

Actual probe command uses pinned Node, explicit 4096 MiB and original 1800 seconds; timeout kills and reaps process group, output path fresh, pass demands actual successful full owner and no native beforeimage exposure.
Full tracked regular files, modes, path sets and both root HEADs are snapshotted; canonical before values compared to retained V10.

findings.detail: snapshot() qualified paths are only extra_paths rooted in 21.x. 188 source gate refs include main ignored/peer paths which are rehashed before launch but absent from post-snapshot; a main-side peer mutation during owner may go undetected while source_unchanged remains true.
findings.fix: Retain qualified line/path keys from V9 receipts and rehash all 188 on both before and after snapshots, plus 21-specific owner extras; ensure after still matches receipt and old snapshot.

findings.detail: The controller checks the number of rejected cold/late cases equals bound count but not the actual cold_source_fault_paths_rejected and late_source_fault_paths_rejected lists. Repeated path with a missing bound path can satisfy counts.
findings.fix: Require unique bound paths and exact equality of both rejected path populations to the unique bound roster, alongside counts and full_source_fault_lifetimes_executed.

findings.detail: Gate heads equal reviewed codecut but before=snapshot() launch heads are never compared to that cut or approved later metadata commits. `current_program_refs_identical_to_successful_regression_cut=true` does not establish full current source-cut identity from 188 files alone.
findings.fix: Assert current root HEADs equal reviewed codecut, or enumerate and independently verify permitted metadata-only descendant commits with unchanged code and 188 physical inputs; record gate codecut and actual launch heads separately.

findings.detail: expected_scope is computed from whatever profile is present without requiring reviewed b263 hash/size, total 188 and 137/51 line counts. Gate source refs include the profile and thus usually catch ordinary drift, but fixed launch contract should not depend on a dynamically changed profile/receipt pair.
findings.fix: Assert exact b263 hash/size, branch keys and unique expected counts before gate verification; compare both receipt rosters by line/path and verify same expected identity for shared refs.

findings.detail: Controller carries inherited NODE_OPTIONS into pinned Node process; preload/instrumentation or heap-affecting options could change the intended unprofiled execution.
findings.fix: Remove NODE_OPTIONS (and document any intentionally inherited runtime-affecting settings) in child environment; keep explicit command and original timeout.

future_checks: After both V9 terminal receipts are durable, repeat independent preflight against exact actual controller hash, real report schema, fault arrays, program cut and 188 hash identities.
Do not claim V9 pass based on a running process or this source-only review; do not run owner before all reviewed checks pass.
